subject: Re: NovaMed - evidence collection for VPC/on-prem deployment validation
messages:
From: Jonathan Barnes <jonathan.barnes@novamed.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com; procurement@novamed.com
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: NovaMed - initial evidence request for private deployment

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — NovaMed is keen to evaluate Redwood for our regulated medtech workloads. The security and ops teams asked us to assemble a short package of deployment evidence to share with our architecture review board next week. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following for an on-prem/VPC (air-gapped possible) deployment?

- High-level network diagram showing egress controls and peering options
- Inventory of cryptographic controls (KMS/HSM integrations) and key rotation cadence
- Ops runbook excerpt for patching and emergency rollback (air-gapped scenarios)
- Any recent third-party audit summaries or SOC2/ISO attestations relevant to private instances

We'd like to collect items by Thursday 11/4 EOD PT. If you need a formal RFI template, I can send one — but the list above will get us started.

Best,
Jonathan Barnes
Director, IT Architecture
NovaMed Solutions
[Attachment: nova_med_requirements.xlsx (xlsx, 34KB)]

From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
To: Jonathan Barnes <jonathan.barnes@novamed.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaMed - initial evidence request for private deployment

Jonathan —

Appreciate the clear list. We can provide each item; below is our proposed delivery plan to get you everything by 11/4 EOD PT:

1) Network diagram & egress controls: Stephanie will attach a VPC/topology diagram and a short narrative on egress gating and allowed flows.
2) KMS/HSM & crypto: Aditya will document supported KMS integrations (cloud KMS, customer-managed HSM) and our key rotation recommendations.
3) Ops runbook excerpt: We'll provide the patch/rollback excerpt for the private deployment playbook including air-gapped patching steps.
4) Audit summaries: We can provide redacted SOC2 summary and a checklist mapping for on-prem controls.

I'll collate everything and upload to a shared Drive link. Quick ask: do you need architecture-level packet-flow diagrams (L4/L7), or is a logical VPC/peering diagram sufficient for your board?

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
[Attachment: request_acknowledgement.txt (txt, 1KB)]

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NovaMed - initial evidence request for private deployment

Looping in details for the deliverables. Per our internal checklist:

- network_diagram_vpc.pdf: logical VPC diagram + sample firewall/NAT layout + egress proxy note (suitable for architecture board). No L7 packet traces.
- onprem_install_matrix.xlsx: mapping of host-level requirements (kernel, container runtime, orchestration) and patch cadence.
- kms_integration_notes.txt: supported providers, customer key import flow, rotation SLA.
- airgap_validation_log.txt: sanitized logs from an internal air-gapped deployment test (non-prod).

Aditya — can you confirm the KMS statement and add the HSM vendor notes? Also flag any items that require legal review before releasing (e.g., audit artifacts).

Thanks — I'll assemble the Drive folder once I have final versions.

—Stephanie
Solutions Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com; Jonathan Barnes <jonathan.barnes@novamed.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaMed - evidence collection for private deployment (DEAL-9742)

Jonathan / Grace / Stephanie —

Attached are the artifacts we discussed. Highlights:

- network_diagram_vpc.pdf: logical VPC + recommended egress-only NAT + optional transit gateway pattern for multi-site NovaMed installs.
- onprem_install_matrix.xlsx: lists required packages, min versions, and suggested downstream hardening tasks.
- kms_integration_notes.txt: we support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, and customer-managed HSMs via PKCS#11. Key rotation recommended every 90 days; emergency rotation playbook included.
- airgap_validation_log.txt: redacted run output from an internal air-gapped install; contains test vectors for offline updates and checksum verification.
- SOC2_summary_redacted.pdf (uploaded to Drive): high-level SOC2 scoped items relevant to private deployments (no customer data).

Attachments: [network_diagram_vpc.pdf (pdf, 220KB)]; [onprem_install_matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)]; [kms_integration_notes.txt (txt, 6KB)]; [airgap_validation_log.txt (txt, 12KB)]

Grace — I also added a short note for legal: the SOC2 summary is intentionally redacted; if NovaMed requires full artifact access we will route through our compliance sharing workflow and an NDA amendment may be needed.

Next steps for NovaMed: confirm if the architecture board needs additional L4/L7 packet-flow detail or a vendor-attested penetration test report. Happy to schedule a 30-minute follow-up.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
